cross_hackathon_clusters.strategy: Build one solid x402 endpoint (domain.verify), deploy to Algorand, reuse for API Cloud AI and ETHGlobal. Same codebase, different competitions.
Build the evaluation framework once (ranking, evidence, adversarial testing). Apply to Telegraph Miner ranking, Alpaca trading evaluation, ETHGlobal agent quality.
Agent that does tasks (cancel subscriptions, manage trades, find deals). Same architecture, different verticals.

recommended_niche.name: x402 Agent Commerce Infrastructure
recommended_niche.why: Overlaps with 3 hackathons, has existing code (x402-endpoints), high combined prize pool, natural fit for agent reliability specialism
recommended_niche.what_to_build: A suite of paid x402 endpoints: domain verification, agent scoring, deal intelligence. Each is a separate endpoint but they share the same payTo address (composite entry). The finalbuilds2 factory auto-deploys new endpoints based on what gets traffic.
